scientific_integrity: Two independent standalone verification programs embedded, runnable with Python 3 standard library and C++17 respectively; complete programs and actual outputs included. No human or independent audit claim.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact classification for the ordinary 12-vertex icosahedral graph only. The exact relocation distances depend on fully enumerated finite graph searches. Indexed searches do not exclude unpublished or unindexed historical priority. title: Antipodal-pair classification and sharp relocation metrics for paired domination on the icosahedron
